changelog:
- Guide pages: padding around the card, a gap under the version line and between the title and text - Guide: five new pages (development flow, Netlify, how deploy works, how the plugin works, basic functions) built from the README, DEVELOPER.md and CLAUDE.md; the running plugin version is shown on every page ({{version}}); release history generated from git tags and commits; docs check in CI - Layout: sidebar and text columns sit on the page edges (space-between); plain header text starts on the sidebar edge (sidebar pages) or the centred text column (full width), whatever the title length; dead name separator rule removed - Services / products / treatments block: generic name in the admin, up to three cards in a count-aware grid (picture + title only, no heading unless typed); guide and a11y fixes (labelled inputs, no 'Reviewed by' in the guide) - Share bar under the text: no extra top margin (the section child-spacing rule no longer reaches widgets) - Full width layout: one table-of-contents block (can be switched off, full width only), no CTA box, share under the text, header aligned left with the text column - Edit article → Company card: restyled with the admin kit (bordered list, status tags, one button per row, soft panel); panels stay closed unless a value is needed; shows what the site uses - Company card per article: one on/off switch per part starting at the site's setting, and every part can get its own value for this page (same fields and validation as the Content tab); the card lays the page's values over the site's - Company card switches: quick clicks no longer overwrite each other; help text explains that a switch only hides or shows what is filled in - Company card: the description is its own full-width row under the picture/name row - Company card address: one block line per part instead of
- Article text headings only (not block titles) use the text font; company card: address uses the full width when there are no hours; Dayo placeholder hours removed - Company card: title can be set per article (Edit article → Company card → Title on this page); empty = the site title, then no heading - Plugin 0.16.2: empty values are never printed (header strip, phone, CTA, sidebar box, author, footer, company card, structured data); company title has no built-in text; Articles list: Tags hidden, fixed Category width, one-line titles, predictable sorting; social links de-duplicated
